Lillio (HiMama): pricing, setup & what to know

An honest owner's guide — and what it costs compared to simpler options.

Lillio — the Canadian platform long known as HiMama — built its reputation on daily reports and developmental documentation. It remains a popular choice, especially for programs that lead with learning stories.

Pricing

Lillio prices by quote, generally per classroom or centre with feature tiers; owners commonly report $100–$300+/month for centres. Like most of the category, expect a demo call before you see your number, and verify current pricing directly.

Setup

  1. Demo → quote → onboarding with their team.
  2. Configure classrooms, import children, set report templates.
  3. Parents download the app; staff learn the documentation flow.

Strengths and trade-offs

Strengths: excellent daily documentation and child development focus, Canadian roots. Trade-offs owners mention: cost at small-centre scale, feature tiers gating things like advanced reports, and the standard big-platform pattern — your program's data lives inside their ecosystem and pricing.
